candidates.duplicate_check_note: Exact event_id, source URL/record ID, DOB NOW job/permit/tracking identifiers, source-date tokens, and title/date/site keys were screened against the manual corpus plus NYC DOB NOW/DOB permit/DOB CO candidate packs through Round581.
